{"sql": "SELECT i.invoice_no, i.customer_no, c.name, c.email, i.due_on, i.amount,
  CAST(julianday('2026-09-29') - julianday(i.due_on) AS INT) AS days_overdue,
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount) FROM erp_payments p WHERE p.invoice_no = i.invoice_no),0) AS paid_amt
FROM erp_invoices i
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_no = i.customer_no
WHERE i.status = 'open'
ORDER BY days_overdue DESC"}
